name: En Dash Org
description: Who owns which slice of founder load, under which constraints, feeding which revenue bets — recreated from org-graview as a document.

person.description: Someone at En Dash: a partner, dasher, or lead — not a reporting-line node.

owns.description: components this person owns (several owners mean shared)

proposedOwner.description: components proposed for this person to take on

strengths.description: what this person is strong at

component.description: An ownership slice of the business: decision rights and outcome accountability.

code.description: the short disc label on the load map

constrainedBy.description: design constraints that bound this slice

constraint.description: A design hard line or preference for how En Dash's OS should work.

revenue-stream.description: A revenue bet: contracts, discoveries, trainings, product, OSS.

open-question.description: An unresolved design question about En Dash's operating system.

involves.description: who or what this question involves

strength.description: Something a person is strong at, and how strong.

add-person.title: Add a person
add-person.description: Bring someone into the org context graph.

add-component.title: Add a component
add-component.description: Declare a new ownership slice of the load map.

add-constraint.title: Add a constraint
add-constraint.description: Record a design hard line or preference for the OS.

add-revenue-stream.title: Add a revenue stream
add-revenue-stream.description: Name a way En Dash makes (or wants to make) money.

record-open-question.title: Record an open question
record-open-question.description: Capture an unresolved design question so it stays visible.

note-strength.title: Note a strength
note-strength.description: Say what this person is strong at.

set-level.title: Set the level
set-level.description: Say how strong a strength is.

update-component-status.title: Update ownership status
update-component-status.description: Set whether Nick still owns it, it is shared, proposed for handoff, or owned elsewhere.

resolve-question.title: Resolve question
resolve-question.description: Mark an open question resolved — it leaves the picture, not the record.

bind-constraint.title: Bind a constraint
bind-constraint.description: Say a component is bounded by a design constraint.

link-feeds.title: Feeds revenue
link-feeds.description: Say a component feeds a revenue stream.

involve-in-question.title: Involve in question
involve-in-question.description: Attach a person or component to an open question.
